Rule text: More than one statement (e.g. an ISO 14064-3 GHG verification plus an AA1000 assurance of the report): the columns from Assurance category to Conclusion follow the statement with the broadest scope, except that (a) metric columns (Scope 1 to 3, Energy, Water, Waste, Social, Other) are Y if any statement covers them, and (b) Figures listed is Y if any statement lists assured figures; Figures match report is then checked against that statement.
Applies to: Assurance columns; metric columns; Figures listed; Figures match report

Rule text: An ISO 14064-3 statement called 'verification' is still coded Independent assurance if it gives a conclusion and names its standard. 'Verification only' applies only where there is no standard and/or no conclusion.

Big 4 mapping in Indonesia: KAP Rintis, Jumadi, Rianto & Rekan (formerly KAP Tanudiredja, Wibisana, Rintis & Rekan) = PwC; KAP Purwanto Susanti dan Surja (formerly KAP Purwantono, Sungkoro & Surja) = EY; KAP Siddharta Widjaja & Rekan = KPMG; KAP Imelda & Rekan = Deloitte. Consulting or advisory entities of the same network are also Big 4 network.
Page references use the PDF file page shown by the PDF viewer, not the number printed on the page.

Where there is no external statement (None found or Internal review only), all assurance columns are N/A rather than N, so that the gap analysis compares only existing statements. Scope disclosure is still coded Y/N for all 45 issuers, so that disclosed-but-not-assured can be counted across the market.
Applies to: Provider type to Figures match report; Scope disclosed

Rule text: Scope disclosed = Y where there is an absolute FY2025 tCO2e figure for that scope, even if Scope 3 covers only some categories. Intensity only = N. Either Scope 2 method (location- or market-based) counts. A per-scope figure that can be calculated from a stated absolute total and stated percentage shares also counts (e.g. ICBP).
Only the issuer's own report is coded. Assurance held by a parent or group and not included in the issuer's report is not counted.
Figures listed = Y where the statement lists the assured figures. Figures match report is filled only when Figures listed = Y, otherwise N/A. 'Not checked' = figures listed but could not be compared.
Reports linked from the IDX website rather than the issuer website are used as they are. If the document turns out to be an annual report, Report type is changed to match its content.

An ESG rating is not assurance and is not an Assurance category. Ratings are recorded separately in ESG rating cited (Y/N, all issuers) and Ratings cited. An issuer can have both. PROPER and awards are not counted as ESG ratings.
Applies to: ESG rating cited; Ratings cited; Assurance category

Rule text: Provider type = Not stated where the report mentions external verification or assurance but does not name the provider.
'Internal review only' applies only where internal audit reviewed the report data. Review by a business unit or the corporate secretary, or Board approval, does not count and is coded None found.
IAPI SPA 3000 (Revised) and SPA 3410 adopt ISAE 3000 and 3410 and are coded as ISAE. A statement using both (3000 for general metrics, 3410 for GHG) is coded 'ISAE 3000 + ISAE 3410'.

AA1000AS Type 1 on the report plus Type 2 on some topics: AA1000 type = Type 2 and Subject matter = Selected indicators. Topics under Type 1 only (adherence to principles) are not counted as assured metrics.
Applies to: AA1000 type; Subject matter; metric columns

Rule text: Metric columns (Scope, Energy, Water, Waste) are Y only if the topic or indicator is named explicitly (e.g. 'Water & Air' gives Water Y; 'Decarbonization' or 'GHG Emission' gives Scope Y). Generic labels such as 'Environmental management' or 'Natural Resource Use' are N and recorded under Other assured topics.
Applies to: Scope, Energy, Water, Waste assured; Other assured topics

Rule text: A provider that is not itself a KAP (e.g. a PT) but belongs to a network that has a KAP is coded by its network, consistent with Rule 3.
Where only part of one scope is assured or verified (e.g. only coal power plant emissions within Scope 1), that scope is N; the covered part is recorded under Other assured topics.
Scope 2 in off-grid operations: if the report gives a figure (including 0), Scope 2 disclosed = Y; if the report states Scope 2 is not calculated or not relevant, without a figure, N/A.

A subject matter that explicitly covers 'all sustainability data or information in the report' is Whole report, and every metric column whose figures are disclosed is Y. Generic topic labels stay N (Rule 15). Basis: ISSA 5000 para 190(c)(iv) allows the assured information to be identified or described.

Exception to Rule 7: a full assurance report published by the issuer itself (e.g. on its website) and referred to from the sustainability report is coded; its location is given in Assurance page reference. Parent or group assurance is still not counted.

Independence statement = Y where the provider itself states independence or freedom from conflicts of interest. 'Not clear' where only the issuer makes the claim or the statement pages are incomplete. N where there is none.

Competence statement = Y where the statement describes the team's qualifications, certifications or experience. A general description of the firm only = N. Shown for information and not scored, since it is not a required element of an ISSA 5000 report.

QM or ethics reference = Y where a named quality management system or standard, or a named ethics code, is cited (e.g. SQM 1/ISQM 1, IAPI Code of Ethics, IESBA, AccountAbility independence and quality rules, ISO 9001 plus the IFIA code). Generic references ('ethical requirements', 'professional code of ethics') = Not clear. None = N.
Assurance level is coded in the statement's own terms, not translated between standards. Where terms are mixed (e.g. 'moderate' and 'limited'), the standard used decides (AA1000 gives Moderate).
Where there is a statement but Scope disclosed = N, Scope assured = N (not N/A). N/A applies only where there is no statement (Rule 5) or the scope is not calculated or not relevant (Rule 18).

Figures listed includes figures in an appendix that forms part of the statement (e.g. Appendix 1 of an EY report). Conclusion = 'Not clear' where the conclusion text is not visible or not explicit in the coded document.
Each coded statement was supported by a short verbatim quote (under 15 words) in the working file. Quotes are not included in this release.
Readiness scoring: 5 ISSA 5000 core criteria and 2 PSPK criteria, defined in the Exhibit 6 tab. 'Not clear' counts as not met. Competence is not scored (Rule 22).
A second check compared provider, standard, level and Scope 1 to 3 against the cited page. Check status is kept in the working file only.
